text: “Who spoke to you? Is this your business?” sneered Bowles, but nearly lost his balance as Clifford swung about and eyed him. “Yes,” he said slowly, “it’s my business.” No one spoke for some time. Then Clifford sang out, “I say, Hastings!” And when Hastings left his easel and came around, he nodded toward the astonished Laffat. “This man has been disagreeable to you, and I want to tell you that any time you feel inclined to kick him, why, I will hold the other creature.” Hastings, embarrassed, said, “Why no, I don’t agree with his ideas, nothing more.” Clifford said “Naturally,” and slipping his arm through Hastings’, strolled about with him, and introduced him to several of his own friends, at which all the nouveaux opened their eyes with envy, and the studio were given to understand that Hastings, although prepared to do menial work as the latest nouveau, was already within the charmed circle of the old, respected and feared, the truly great.
